notes.summary: Ratio compares two quantities of the same kind; proportion says two ratios are equal. Partnership is ratio applied to investment × time. 1–2 questions per tier.

concepts.title: Ratio basics
concepts.body: a : b = a/b. Multiplying or dividing both terms by the same number does not change the ratio. To divide N in a : b, the parts are N × a/(a + b) and N × b/(a + b).

concepts.title: Proportion
concepts.body: If a : b = c : d then ad = bc. Fourth proportional of a, b, c = bc/a. Mean proportional of a and b = √(ab). Third proportional of a and b = b²/a.

concepts.title: Partnership
concepts.body: Profit is shared in the ratio of capital × time. A partner who joins later is counted only for the months they invested.

varieties.name: Dividing and changing ratios
varieties.how: Write the quantities as ax and bx, apply the change, and solve for x.

example.q: Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 3. If 5 is added to each, the ratio becomes 3 : 4. Find the numbers.

varieties.name: Proportion and compound ratio
varieties.how: Use cross multiplication; to combine A : B and B : C, make B equal in both.

example.q: Find the third proportional to 4 and 6.

varieties.name: Partnership
varieties.how: Share = capital × months; divide profit in that ratio.

example.q: A invests ₹ 5000 for 12 months, B ₹ 6000 for 10 months. Profit ratio?

tips: To combine A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 5, multiply to make B the same: 8 : 12 : 15.
Check answers by putting them back into the ratio.
traps: A ratio is not the actual amount; multiply by the common factor x.
In partnership, count only the months each partner’s money was in the business.

A and B start a business with ₹ 30,000 and ₹ 45,000. After 4 months, C joins with ₹ 60,000. Out of a total annual profit of ₹ 23,000, what is C’s share?
Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5. If 9 is subtracted from each, the new numbers are in the ratio 12 : 23. What is the smaller number?
questions.solution:
Let the numbers be 3x and 5x.
(3x − 9)/(5x − 9) = 12/23 → 69x − 207 = 60x − 108.
9x = 99 → x = 11. Smaller number = 33.
